newsitem.title: GREECE: Athens bourse still working on problem- official.
newsitem.headline: Athens bourse still working on problem- official.

text.p: Trading at the Athens bourse was restarted and then stopped again on Tuesday as a problem with the electronic screen-based system was not fixed, brokers said.
There has been no official statement by the authorities on the fault, but an official at the exchange's computer department told Reuters there was a software problem with the trading system.
"There will be an official statement soon," Anastasios Sgouros, an official at the exchange's computer department told Reuters.
The Athens general share index was stuck at 907.77, down 0.14 percent on volume of 182 million drachmas. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
